notes.title: Release Bugs Corrected
notes.notes:
As with all ports to steam from xbox there are chances I will miss bugs doing tests in my environment (little lag between test machine connection for example).

Two fixes thus far and will require you get the update if you bought the game earlier today:

1. Joining games that have ended should no longer be allowed. (It was free points for those that figured that one out).

2. Randomly losing connection while destroying blocks should be fixed.
